newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZCCM to reopen Luanshya smelter on standby.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM to reopen Luanshya smelter on standby.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd (ZCCM) said on Tuesday it would reopen its Luanshya smelter as a standby facility.
A spokesman said the smelter, which was shut down in February 1994, had been rebuilt at a cost of $7.7 million and would be operational by the end of the month.
"The smelter...will be placed on care and maintenance and will only start operating when excess ZCCM concentrator or toll concentrates are available," the spokesman said.
"It will also be used as a standby facility and insurance for ZCCM in case of major problems at Mufulira or Nkana smelters."
ZCCM said 65,000 tonnes of copper concentrate could have been treated last year if there had been sufficient smelter capacity.
Last July, ZCCM suffered a 5,022-tonne production shortfall following a fire at the Mufulira smelter.
